lines.text: Morning to the four of you! Fresh out of the hearth oven not ten minutes ago, still warm enough to melt butter.
Morning, Silas! What a gift to see Daeris resting undisturbed in her own home, now that her soul-tax lien and necrotic tether to the Reach's engines are completely extinguished.
Morning, Ammut. That bread smells wonderful. What brings you by the shop today?
Good mid-morning to you all. The frost is finally clearing off the roof. What brings the whole household across the square today?
Lucky bolts, is it? Well, I suppose the sill could use the luck, though they tend to roll if Peet slams the shutters.
